name: Tome of the Cabal
summary: In the Barrens, Strahad Farsan awaits the tome and rods needed to bind a felhunter. The warlock brings them so his circle can prepare the rite.

sections.title: A Grudging Hand-Off
sections.body: Krom Stoutarm binds the Tome of the Cabal's tattered remnants in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. The dwarf scholar parts with the rare work reluctantly, after securing a promise of a copy. He also gives the warlock a fresh missive from Strahad Farsan. The tome holds rites for breaching the Nether, but parchment alone cannot conduct them.

sections.title: Stolen Relics of the Dragonmaw
sections.body: Strahad's acolytes need implements to focus the energies used to bind a felhunter. Krom sends the warlock to the Wetlands, where Dragonmaw spellcasters carry rods of channeling. The hostile orcs guard the rods. Taken from them, the rods give Strahad's circle a conduit to control the rift and steady the summoned energies.

sections.title: Back to the Barrens
sections.body: At Strahad's tower above Ratchet, the restored tome and channeling rods complete the difficult preparations. The text is translated and the instruments are ready. Strahad prepares the dangerous binding rite, where the summoner's will faces a hound of the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Why does Strahad need rods of channeling?
faq.answer: Strahad's acolytes use the rods to focus and steady the energies needed to summon and bind a felhunter. This helps keep the portal from collapsing or running wild.

faq.q: Where are the rods of channeling found?
aliases: where to get rods of channeling
faq.answer: Dragonmaw orc spellcasters in the Wetlands carry the rods of channeling, especially around the marshes and ruins they occupy.

faq.q: Why was Krom Stoutarm involved in a warlock ritual?
aliases: why is an ironforge dwarf helping a warlock
faq.answer: Krom Stoutarm is a master researcher in Ironforge, skilled at translating, preserving, and rebuilding damaged ancient manuscripts. His interest in rare antiquities led him to restore the Tome of the Cabal's corrupted pages.

faq.q: What happens after giving the tome and rods to Strahad?
aliases: next quest after tome of the cabal 3
faq.answer: After you give Strahad the tome and rods, he begins the binding rite atop his tower. You face the summoned felhunter and try to subdue it.

Strahad Farsan is a powerful warlock in a solitary tower on the cliffs above Ratchet in the Barrens. Experienced practitioners across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms defer to his mastery of demonology.

faq.q: Is the Tome of the Cabal used by the Horde as well?
faq.answer: Horde warlocks follow their own Tome of the Cabal rites, with leads to different contacts across Kalimdor and the Undercity rather than Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a warlock, subduing a felhunter marks your passage from pacts with imps and voidwalkers to mastering predatory demons made to devour arcane magic.
As an Alliance summoner, you travel between Ironforge, the misty bogs of the Wetlands, and Ratchet, the neutral goblin port in Kalimdor.
As a dwarf, you know the value of careful preservation. In Ironforge's Hall of Explorers, Krom Stoutarm pieces ruined relics back together.
